[quote=skullsbrough;60232909][b][i]Admiral Vivian:[/i][/b] "[i]Admiral Jacob Vivan. of the flousechian. I well I guess former navy. We...fled the country about 2 weeks ago, and as you can probably tell. Are not in the best shape. Im going to be frank. No other country is willing to take us in, where running out of drinkable water, edible food, oil, ammo, and pratically everything you can imagine. Ontop of that where constantly harassed by the air forces of the revolutionaries. We've already last a missle cruiser, a destroyer, and a supply ship with half of our food just this week. [/i]"

[i]He sighs, deeply shamed by what he is going to say next[/i]

"Where here to attempt to negotiate "surrendering" to your country for your word that you won't sell us out to the revolutionaries..."

[i]He sighs rather dispointed and embarrsed[/i][/quote]

The steward of the House frowned, the matter was far more serious than what he had expected...the mere notion of a government in exile in the borders of the empire, it was practically new territory for Thýven...and what of the legal aspects, would it estrange the nation from whatever other state had ousted the government? Yet, humanitarian guarantee was one thing enshrined in various codes for Thýven, especially since the fall of the dictatorship in the 80s. However, despite having all of these things in his mind, he could only reply.

"This is a matter with which we must see the Emperor about, I shall order medical aid to be brought immediately,"

Turning to his retainers, who stood behind him he nodded for them to make haste.
